name: Ro64-6198
summary: Ro64-6198 is an opioid drug used in scientific research. It acts as a potent and selective agonist for the nociceptin receptor, also known as the ORL-1 (opiate receptor like-1) receptor, with over 100x selectivity over the other opioid receptors.

pharmacology.text: It acts as a potent and selective agonist for the nociceptin receptor, also known as the ORL-1 (opiate receptor like-1) receptor, with over 100x selectivity over the other opioid receptors. It has been shown to reduce alcohol self-administration in animals and suppressed relapses in animal models of alcoholism, and ORL-1 agonists may have application in the treatment of alcoholism.

uses.text: Ro64-6198 is an opioid drug used in scientific research. It has been shown to reduce alcohol self-administration in animals and suppressed relapses in animal models of alcoholism, and ORL-1 agonists may have application in the treatment of alcoholism.

fact.en: Ro64-6198 acts on the nociceptin receptor, the fourth member of the opioid receptor family, which was only identified in 1994. Drugs acting on it do not cause classic opioid effects.
fact.zh: Ro64-6198 作用於痛敏肽受體，這是鴉片受體家族的第四個成員，直到 1994 年才被鑑定出來。作用於它的藥物不會產生典型的鴉片類效果。
fact.zhHans: Ro64-6198 作用于痛敏肽受体，这是鸦片受体家族的第四个成员，直到 1994 年才被鉴定出来。作用于它的药物不会产生典型的鸦片类效果。
